description: This file defines a React functional component named UploadForm that provides a user interface for uploading a PDF document, multiple old logo images, a new logo image, and optional parameters such as DPI, maximum pages, and match threshold. It handles user input, validation, and triggers a callback to start a logo replacement job.

methods.name: UploadForm
methods.description: React functional component that renders a form for uploading files and parameters, and handles form submission to initiate a logo replacement process.
